data.narrative:
Oxford Nanopore Technologies is a public-stage biotech company in the Biotech & Health sector that has raised over $1B to date. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 4 same-sector, same-stage peers: Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M).

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach, given the absence of disclosed revenue data that would enable P/S multiple application. The median valuation across the 4-company peer set is $1.1B, with a range spanning $539M to $1.6B. This method anchors to direct comparables in stage and sector, providing a market-based reference point for public-stage biotech valuations.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $910M to $1.2B, centered on the peer median of $1.1B. Key uncertainties include Oxford Nanopore's revenue scale and growth trajectory relative to peers—data not available in this analysis—as well as the stability of the biotech public market for mid-cap companies. The tight reliance on a single methodological input (peer-median) reflects data constraints rather than analytical consensus, and any material divergence from peer fundamentals would warrant range revision.
